text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the Arima Kinen was 
Zenno Rob Roy, effectively returning the 
blow to Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Praising each other's fighting spirit, the 
two vowed to keep running together from 
now on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To one day surpass myself in another 
universe and get closer to my ideal self.
